comment: The DSP for this module is not in the public repository, so the filter position ordering and the exact ranges of the resonator and ambience controls come from the maker's tooltips and the panel, not from code. The randomise slew time (param 48) is a menu slider with no place on the panel, so it is untagged and covered by a Menu line. A SYNC label appears on the panel near the MOD LEVEL knob with no control of its own at that spot; what it marks could not be settled. The docs/ folder of the source carries a manual for Befaco Oneiroi, which is a different and larger module; nothing in it was used here. The left and right inputs take a polyphonic cable and sum every channel to one (Iroi.cpp:765); the module itself is mono, and the maker does not tag it Polyphonic.
